root_idea.summary: A root principle of resemblance and conformity in color, quality, description, or other attributes.
root_idea.development: The core notion extends from likeness between things to assimilation and comparison, mutual resemblance, and uncertainty arising when similar things or meanings are difficult to distinguish. A related nominal branch names materials or plants identified by resemblance.

senses.definition: To make someone or something appear to be, or be taken for, another; in the Quranic passive construction, it was made to appear to them as the person they supposed it to be.
senses.usage_conditions: Quran-attested in the passive form شُبِّهَ, with the identity of the person believed to have been crucified made to appear to the observers.

senses.definition: To resemble one another, become alike, or share a likeness in an attribute or condition.
senses.usage_conditions: Used mutually of things, persons, qualities, or states; the Quran also applies the construction to hearts sharing error and ignorance.

senses.definition: To become equivocal or difficult to distinguish because of resemblance; to be ambiguous in interpretation.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction ما تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ, the resemblance among meanings or passages makes the intended interpretation unclear or open to differing interpretations.

senses.definition: Resembling one another in a way that makes things difficult to distinguish; similar or liable to be confused.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic produce context, the resemblance is between the things themselves and may result in confusion or doubt about their identity or properties.

senses.definition: Resembling or conformable in its several parts; similar in appearance, quality, or arrangement.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied to created things that resemble one another without requiring identity in every property, and to the Quran when its parts correspond in wisdom, rulings, and orderly composition.

senses.definition: Equivocal or ambiguous, especially of Quranic verses whose intended meaning is not immediately determinate.
senses.usage_conditions: The ambiguity is explained as arising from resemblance to other passages or meanings; interpretation may require reference to clearer verses, repeated consideration, or deeper knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one thing like another; to assimilate, liken, or compare it with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes the compared object with بِـ or an equivalent construction; the likeness may be real, ideal, or figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render something confused, ambiguous, dubious, or obscure by making it appear like something else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which the resulting uncertainty is imposed on another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To image or represent something to someone in the mind; to make it seem so.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the mind or circumstances presenting an image, comparable to خَيَّلَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A comparison, simile, similitude, or parable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun and substantivized expression for the act or result of comparing one thing with another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To resemble or become like someone or something; to share one of its qualities or attributes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The resemblance may concern a particular quality rather than complete identity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become impotent and weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative use in the expression of a man resembling his mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: How like or similar something is to another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the verb-of-wonder construction مَا أَشْبَهَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make oneself like another; to assume, affect, or imitate another's likeness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Normally construed with بِـ and used of adopting another person's or thing's manner or appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become imaged in the mind as being so; to seem or appear to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A mental-perception construction equivalent to imagining or supposing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutual resemblance, likeness, or conformity; equality or uniformity in appearance or quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun describing things that resemble one another or correspond in their features.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become confused, dubious, uncertain, or obscure; to be difficult to distinguish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The confusion may result from resemblance or from another cause, and an affair may be obscure to a particular person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A like or similar person or thing; an analogue, match, or fellow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of likeness, with plural أَشْبَاهٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A likeness, resemblance, or semblance between two things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing resemblance between persons or things; also synonymous with شِبْهٌ in this branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fine yellow brass or copper alloy resembling gold in color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material noun named for its resemblance to gold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confusedness, dubiousness, uncertainty, or a doubt-producing appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a matter in which the truth or proper classification is not readily distinguished; plural forms include شُبَهٌ and شُبْهَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thorny plant or tree, variously identified, with an elegant red blossom and medicinally described seeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical sources preserve several variant vocalizations and identifications for this plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grain resembling حُرْف, taken as a medicine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medicinal grain or seed; the entry also records a variant vocalization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most like; more closely resembling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative form used in comparisons such as one date being more like another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most suitable, fitting, or appropriate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative use meaning that something is more suitable to a person or circumstance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Applied to a plant called نَصِيّ, becoming yellow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plant-related adjective or participial use.

cautions: The Quranic Form II occurrence is passive شُبِّهَ; the public headword is normalized to the active perfect citation form شَبَّهَ.
